crossRefs.note: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold…
Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing…
They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he…
and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit…
I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly…
I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not…
His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into…
When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s…
But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
translations.bsb: Many came to Him and said, “Although John never performed a sign, everything he said about this man was true.”
translations.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
translations.asv: And many came unto him; and they said, John indeed did no sign: but all things whatsoever John spake of this man were true.
